summary: This sheet is a working renewal pipeline for the Q4 2026 scrub. Primary goal: triage accounts by financial impact (ARR) and risk score to prioritize outreach. Use probabilities for ARR-weighted forecasting and pull into monthly renewal meeting. Rows are intentionally terse — expand notes into linked playbook actions when account moves to 'engaged' stage.
scoring_method: Risk Score: composite 1-10 (1 low risk) = (Usage trend * 0.4) + (Support health * 0.3) + (Contract complexity * 0.2) + (Exec engagement * 0.1)
Renewal Probability: baseline from historical (70%) adjusted by recent NPS, exec activity, procurement status
ARR weighting: use ARR in thousands; weighted forecast = ARR * (Renewal Probability / 100)
Red-flag override: any account with Risk Score >=8 requires immediate senior CS + AE + Solutions sync
playbook_snippets: Standard renewal LOE: 2 weeks for straightforward renewals (score <=4), 4-8 weeks for mid-risk, 8+ weeks for high-risk with legal/security items
Escalation path: CS owner -> CS Lead -> Solutions Eng -> CRO (if ARR > $500k) -> Legal/Compliance loop
Discount guidelines: auto-approve up to 10% for renewals < $300k with product justification; >10% requires GTM director approval
Engagement templates: 'Usage Narrative' email, 'Value Recap' slide deck, 'Proof of Performance' latency/throughput bench report
grooming_checklist: Confirm contract end date and auto-renew clause (yes/no)
Validate ARR and check for planned expansions or seat adds
Confirm exec sponsor on customer side and date of last executive touch
Surface any outstanding support tickets that materially impact value
Attach product benchmark artifacts when performance is a negotiation factor
Set follow-up cadence in calendar with clear owner and outcome
action_plan: Week 1: Triage top 20% ARR by weighted risk -> assign senior CS + AE
Week 2-3: Execute targeted playbook per customer bucket (low/mid/high risk)
Week 4: Finalize legal and procurement checklist for accounts with compliance needs
Ongoing: Update this sheet after each major interaction and tag linked JIRA tickets
red_flags: Security evidence gap (e.g., no SOC2 or encryption mismatch)
